decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm’s existing fluid-handling and fabricated-metal capabilities, and no clear shortfall is visible yet in a growing industry, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it on the market.

Because public waste bins are more distant from the firm’s established offer, any early performance below aspiration would more readily trigger problemistic search and reallocation of resources back to stronger core-related products.

Because this product line builds directly on the firm’s established metalworking and public-infrastructure customer base, management would likely see enough strategic fit and learning potential to continue it.

Because cast iron ground sleeves are a related extension using overlapping production and sales resources, management is likely to keep the variant while it compares results against aspirations for the broader line.
Because steel ground sleeves fit existing fabrication strengths and likely require limited additional organisational commitment, management would usually keep them unless results clearly disappoint.
